jobs.crash_recovery_policy: resume only before encryption publication when snapshot/checkpoint fingerprints still match; otherwise remove temp and restart from fresh consistent snapshot; any copy of this job found inside a later-restored historical backup is invalidated by LLD-01 restore reconciliation before READY and is never resumed merely because the snapshot contained it
jobs.cancellation_policy: allowed before final publication/verified-catalog commit; cancellation never prunes existing backup
jobs.sensitive_field_policy: job payload/checkpoint contain backup_id only; managed root key/backup key/DEK stay process memory and are reacquired through security providers
jobs.coalescing: at most one active managed backup job per data_instance_id; later automatic request coalesces, explicit manual request receives existing-active identity

jobs.crash_recovery_policy: before each attempt reconcile deterministic prune quarantine files against command receipts and managed_backup_catalog: restore quarantine to canonical final path when no committed prune exists, delete quarantine when matching committed prune state exists, fail closed on digest/identity ambiguity; then recompute the eligible set from current catalog/files and invoke one fresh PruneManagedBackups COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 operation
jobs.cancellation_policy: safe before starting a PruneManagedBackups command or after that command reaches committed/rolled-back recoverable boundary; no cooperative cancellation is acted upon between first quarantine rename and authoritative transaction resolution
jobs.sensitive_field_policy: job payload contains only data_instance_id/retention_count orchestration data and never backup keys, live DEK, recovery secret or unrestricted path
jobs.coalescing: one pending prune per data_instance_id; repeated scheduler requests coalesce and never share the authoritative command_id of a completed prune

rules: portable backup is synchronous operator export so recovery secret never enters durable job state
restore is quiescing recovery choreography, not background job
job completion records verified/failed state through short LLD-01 UnitOfWork and never claims success before self-verification
historical nonterminal backup jobs contained in a restored database are invalidated by LLD-01 restore reconciliation before any coordinator claim is allowed
